name: sales-cloud-v2-mcp
description: MCP Server for SAP Sales Cloud V2 — Accounts, Opportunities, Leads, Contacts, Activities, and raw OData queries

credentials._comment: All credentials live ONLY in .env at the project root. Copy .env.example → .env and fill in the two required values. Never put credentials in any MCP config file.

required.description: Base URL of your SAP Sales Cloud V2 tenant (e.g. https://sandbox.api.sap.com or your real tenant https://my123456.crm.cloud.sap)
API key — obtain from Settings > API Keys in your tenant

steps: 1. Clone this repo and run: npm install && npm run build
3. Fill in SALES_CLOUD_BASE_URL and SALES_CLOUD_API_KEY in .env — that is the only place credentials go
4a. Claude Code: .mcp.json is already committed — the server registers automatically when you open this project
4b. Claude Desktop: add the snippet from claude_desktop_snippet below to your claude_desktop_config.json (no credentials needed there)

claude_desktop_snippet._comment: Add under mcpServers in %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json (Windows) or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS). Adjust the path. Credentials come from .env — do NOT add them here.
